description: Which architecture-state finding codes a JSON Schema validator can express, and which only the native validator in bin/architecture/state.py can. `schema-and-native` codes must be rejected by BOTH; `native-only` codes are cross-object, uniqueness, ordering, or hashing invariants that draft-07 cannot state, so a fixture invalid only via one of them is legitimately schema-valid on its own. test_schema_conformance.py reads this file to decide which direction to assert.

excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CONFIG_BAD_BINDING: architecture.project rejects a binding ARGUMENT at mutation time -- a duplicate alias, a duplicate binding_id, or a malformed alias. The document that would result is always schema-valid; what is refused is the request to create it, which no schema can state.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_PREVIEW_CONFIG_MISSING: architecture.preview reports the ABSENCE of config.json. There is no document for a schema to validate.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_PREVIEW_CONFIG_INVALID: a wrapper announcing that preview refuses to plan against a config that failed validation; the per-field findings accompanying it carry their own classified codes, so the invariant itself is covered there rather than here.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_PREVIEW_GRAPH_UNUSABLE: graphset.load_set refused the structural-graph config preview derived from the architecture config. A caller-argument failure, not an invariant of a persisted architecture document.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_PREVIEW_BINDING_UNKNOWN: a --graph argument names a binding_id absent from the config. A property of the INVOCATION, not of either document.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_PREVIEW_ALLOCATION_REFUSED: the allocator refused a batch (slug collision, or a name from which no slug can be derived). A refusal to create identities, not a defect in a stored document.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_PREVIEW_IDENTITY_UNPLACEABLE: the judgments log knows an identity that index.json records no note_path for, and neither the log nor the identity_allocation payload stores one. A cross-file reachability gap rather than a property of either file; see the open question on #374 about making the log self-sufficient.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_PREVIEW_PLAN_REJECTED: planner.plan rejected this run's inputs. Reports a planning OUTCOME -- the same family as the excluded E_ARCH_APPLY_* run outcomes.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CONFIG_MISSING: architecture.project reports the ABSENCE of config.json, not a property of one. There is no document for a schema to validate, and a missing config is a legitimate pre-init state rather than a defect, so neither validator can or should express it.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CONFIG_UNREADABLE: architecture.project reports bytes that could not be read or parsed as JSON. A schema validates a parsed document; there is no parsed document here, and the recovery is an operator looking at the file rather than a validation fix.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_BAD_PROJECTION_TYPE: matcher caller-input validation: a candidate is planning state a caller passes in, never a persisted document, so no JSON Schema governs it.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_BAD_SIGNAL: matcher caller-input validation: signal fields are validated at the call boundary, not on disk.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_DUPLICATE_KEY: matcher caller-input validation: uniqueness across the candidate list passed to match(), which is not a document.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_MALFORMED_KEY: matcher caller-input validation: candidate keys are per-run planning joins, never persisted state.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_MISSING_FIELD: matcher caller-input validation: enforces CANDIDATE_REQUIRED at the call boundary.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_NOT_AN_OBJECT: matcher caller-input validation: shape of an argument, not of a stored object.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_UNKNOWN_FIELD: matcher caller-input validation: the hard abort that refuses provider-specific fields rather than ignoring them.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_THRESHOLDS_BAD_ORDER: matcher caller-input validation: thresholds arrive as an argument; config.thresholds itself is covered by E_ARCH_CONFIG_BAD_THRESHOLDS.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_THRESHOLDS_BAD_VALUE: matcher caller-input validation: same argument-boundary check as above.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_THRESHOLDS_OUT_OF_RANGE: matcher caller-input validation: same argument-boundary check as above.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_APPLY_UNCONFIRMED: apply-run outcome: reports that no confirmed plan fingerprint was supplied to this invocation. Ephemeral invocation state by design (the fingerprint travels as a token, never as a persisted field), so no document exists for a schema to govern.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_APPLY_STALE_PREVIEW: apply-run outcome: reports that inputs moved between preview and apply. A comparison between a run's recomputed digest and a token held by the caller, not a property of any file on disk.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_APPLY_PLAN_REJECTED: apply-run outcome: surfaces a planner PlanInputError (unrankable records, an unplaceable slug, a planned path escaping the notes home) at the apply boundary. The underlying documents have their own codes; this one names the run that refused.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_APPLY_IDENTITY_REFUSED: apply-run outcome: an identity_allocation record the caller supplied would not read back, so the append was refused and nothing was written. The record's own invalidity is E_ARCH_JUDGMENTS_INVALID_RECORD; this code reports the aborted run.
